item.title: A message from the Cafeteria:
item.description: Come visit the Cafeteria, take a look at what we have and say Hi! The cafeteria has lots of baked good, healthy options and on the go items.

item.title: A message from Mr. Warner.
item.description: The junior girls' basketball team will be hosting Osgoode High School on Tuesday at 3 pm here at STA. All are welcome to attend.

item.title: A message from Mme. Bertrand:
item.description: Calling all Crochet and Knitting artists. Dishin' Out Kindness, our Grade 9 to 12 crochet and knitting club will have its first meeting today in Rm. 213 at 10:45. We welcome new members and members from last year. Looking forward to seeing you there. Merci!

item.title: A message from Mr. Curtis:
item.description: Sign up for 'Yardbirds' continues this week for senior music students. Audition piece is now avaiblable for pick up. Please see Mr. Curtis at lunch if you have any questions.

item.title: A message from Mr. D'Alessio:
item.description: Attention Drama people. All those in gr.9-12 who are interested in being an actor or crew member with the Drama Club please come to Rm.209 Wednesday at lunch. New members welcome.

item.title: A message from Mr. Vonesch:
item.description: Any students in grade 9-12 who have signed up--or would still like to sign up--for liturgy music ministry, please come to the chapel at lunch today to practice. Thank you!

item.title: A message from Mr. Kwok:
item.description: There will be a quick yearbook meeting for the design team today at lunch in portable 316

item.title: A message from Mr Kwok:
item.description: A reminder of the high school girls soccer tryout today after school from 2:30-3:30.
